steps.title: Fabricate Row 5
items: Assemble full leg for Row 2 by leg segments
Fabricate and assemble Row 5
- Set up temporary supports and levelling check
- Lifting, moving and place Leg C, then Leg B, then Leg A onto temporary supports; dimension and levelling check
- Lifting, moving and install the horizontal braces onto the temporary supports; perform dimensional and level checks
- For horizontal braces with double side weld, node break-out is required to facilitate double side welding, in this sequence:
+ Lift, move and position the horizontal braces, including the additional stubs with stiffeners, onto the temporary supports
+ Fit up and reinforce diagonal braces to Legs A/B/C
+ Weld the outside stub pipes to Legs A/B/C
+ Cut and remove the stiffeners connecting horizontal braces to the stub pipes
+ Removal horizontal braces
+ Weld the inside stub pipes to Legs A/B/C
+ NDT check
+ Re-install horizontal braces
- Lifting, moving and position diagonal braces including the additional stubs with stiffeners onto the temporary supports; perform dimensional and level checks
- Fit up and reinforce diagonal braces to Legs A/B/C
- Weld the outside stub pipes to Legs A/B/C
- Cut and remove the stiffeners connecting diagonal braces to the stub pipes
- Removal diagonal braces
- Weld the inside stub pipes to Legs A/B/C
- NDT check
- Re-install diagonal braces to Row 5
